request.title: Keep equipment identity text and stat tokens readable in constrained cards
request.description: Manual review of the current enlarged-phone Equipment screenshots shows gear names and stat values squeezed into glyph-wide columns beside artwork. Nested preset cards are especially narrow even though the document has no horizontal overflow.
request.expected_behavior: Allow equipment artwork and identity text to stack when necessary, use the available text width, and wrap complete stat tokens without splitting labels or numeric values into vertical glyphs.
request.source: .skill-tree/artifacts/ux-ui/game-control-names/1793726429958835000/webkit-obsidian-glow-game-inventory-context.png; current habitica-item-identity grid and inventory-stat-value rules.
request.priority_reason: Long names and stat values fail the parent rendered readability acceptance despite bounded outer geometry.
